# teams agent update-identifier

Set the bot's AAD app identifier URI (SSO URI) to the Teams-required api://botid-{botId} format

## Usage

```
teams agent update-identifier [options]
```

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Details

Sets the SSO identifier URI on the bot's AAD app registration (created by `teams agent create --m365`) to the Teams-required `api://botid-{botId}` format. Teams' validation regex requires the exact `botid-` prefix — a common manual mistake when running `az ad app update --identifier-uris` by hand. This command derives the correct value automatically from `a365.generated.config.json` and runs `az ad app update --id <botAppId> --identifier-uris api://botid-<botId>`.

### Prerequisites

- An agent identity created with [`teams agent create --m365`](./create) (must include a bot registration)
- Logged in: `teams login`
- Azure CLI installed and logged in (`az login`) to the same tenant as `teams login`

### Examples

```bash
teams agent update-identifier
```

### Output

On success (human mode), outputs the bot app ID and the identifier URI that was set. With `--json`, outputs:

```json
{
  "botAppId": "...",
  "identifierUri": "api://botid-...",
  "generatedConfigPath": "/path/to/a365.generated.config.json"
}
```
